summary: Harlem Village Academies argues for continued poverty‑based discounts, recognition of high‑cost urban needs, active LCP oversight, and local control over screen‑time and parent opt‑out policies. Harlem Village Academies urges the FCC to preserve the core E‑Rate program, maintain broad eligibility, avoid one‑size‑fits‑all screen‑time limits, and keep special construction and dark fiber support.
